_note: Endless-improvement backlog. The improver cron ships ONE genuine upgrade per run, logs it to done, and when pending runs thin it generates new real improvements. Quality over volume — never degrade the site, never pad, always keep the build green.

done.title: FEATURE: generate an RSS 2.0 feed (docs/feed.xml) of posts + pages; link it in <head> and the footer

Feed lists the blog post (newest first) then evergreen content pages (excludes the homepage + the ProfilePage About). Wired both as rel=alternate in <head> sitewide and added footer 'Subscribe: RSS · JSON' links. Validated: index SEO checks pass, feed.xml well-formed XML, feed.json valid JSON Feed 1.1 (8 items), build green.
